overview_description.description:
CrowdANALYTIX provides cloud-based crowd-sourced analytics services using public sources of data to support the need for analytics by professional services firms. It solves customer problems using public and syndicated data through its crowdsourcing platform. 

CrowdANALYTIX converts business challenges into analytics competitions; and addresses the need for analytical solutions requiring predictive analytics, descriptive analytics, estimations, and business hypothesis validation. Divyabh Mishra founded it on April 24, 2012, with its headquarters in Campbell in California with an additional office in Bengaluru in India.
